summary: Validated MongoDB health, user upsert, application persistence, and saved-toggle round trips; browser coverage confirmed professional workspace and application review/submission rendering. Two prior frontend regressions remain unresolved.

integration_issues.issue: Prior report found the detail-page save control had no observable persistence/state change; requires retest after fix.
Prior report found /student/signup and /professional/signup render sign-in mode because Auth initializes signup false instead of deriving it from pathname.

action_items: Fix detail save persistence/state and direct signup route initialization, then rerun browser regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Several visible controls remain no-op (forgot password, profile editing, workspace tune profile, mark notifications read); either implement demo behavior or clearly communicate unavailable functionality.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed Mongo users, applications, and saved toggles during API tests; no seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend persistence is green. Professional workspace and application review/submission rendered; browser scripts had strict-selector/viewport assertion issues, not confirmed app failures. Share/download was not reached in the final run.
rca of the issue: Signup mode is controlled by Auth useState(false) and ignores the /signup pathname. Detail save previously rendered without a handler/state update. Browser mobile assertions also need menu opening and scroll-to-content before visibility checks.
